long_biography.plain_text:
Grupo Shahani grew under Víctor Shahani Rodríguez from a Panamanian family concern into a developer working across housing, commercial sites, industrial parks and resorts. As president and later chief executive, he sought outside design and construction partners while keeping ownership beside his brother Rolando. A 2023 securities prospectus recorded each brother with half of the holding company behind a principal property affiliate.

Shahani also treated housing as a public-interest programme. Through a partnership with the Global Housing Foundation, the group allocated six homes to women rebuilding after serious personal or family hardship, with each recipient holding the property deed. The company later began bringing a third family generation into management.
